title: Reserve Duty Reform Blocked
body: Attorney General Gali Baharav-Meara blocks IDF plan to cancel extended emergency call-ups and cap reserve service at 70 days, citing need to draft Chareidim.

title: Death Threats Against Rabbi
body: Police investigate anonymous threats against Rabbi Zevadia Cohen, who's running for Tel Aviv chief rabbi, demanding he withdraw from the race. Officers collected surveillance footage from his home.

title: Yeshivos Move Up Schedules
body: Many tri-state yeshivos are ending their spring/summer periods early, starting the new school year in mid-August, weeks ahead of the traditional start.
